name: blend-management-system
description: Blend Coffee & Tea Fullstack Management System (React + Vite + Node.js + SQLite)

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage
